baseline: Frozen C7 d6, threshold112, actual Q4d PL download; A/C2/C5 unchanged
selection_annotation: Original training AH only; all 20 images have previously been inspected, no claim of fresh holdout
bright_protection: max(raw green in replicated17x17)>=192. No additions in protected region. Original Gaussian3 bright core+radius7 band is a subset, with no GT in protection. Baseline predictions preserved exactly.
fov_protection: No new pixels within8 pixels of original FOV boundary; baseline C7 pixels preserved
weak_support: Frozen R3 d8 grouped score>=64/96 AND SAME-direction point+longitudinal raw support from r2, outside unchanged protection. C7 seed exact, no C5 union.
connectivity: Four/eight bounded8-neighbor synchronous stages using only eligible weak ridge pixels.
selection: Only unchanged r1 quality-gate eligible; rank whole Dice+clDice then smaller forest/fewer stages. Existing R3 folds reused, report this adaptivity. Freeze full model before old heldout/VK; no later retune.
post_selection_gates: All40 cases xAH/VK: bright core/band pixel identity and baseline-mask superset; each image nondecreasing Dice, thin/centerline recall and adjacent-edge coverage; each size/split/observer mean clDice nondecreasing; im0324/512 both observers thin and centerline recall strictly improve. Any failure rejects the candidate for next board release, no post-evaluation retune.
resource_preflight: Additional fixed residual forest plus reciprocal normalized features and bounded windows; actual Z2 resources/timing required.
reason: R3 high confidence adds primarily wider edges; mean512Dice improves up to0.0084 but thin gain<=0.0166 and clDice declines. Use grouped residual confidence at lower thresholds only for image-supported dark ridges connected to original C7, rejecting isolated false detections.
